subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a lock is approved, the system shall make the draft's PRD and tech spec immutable together as the feature's next locked version and record the approver in both the product and the engineering roles.
rationale: One lock for the whole contract; one person may hold both roles (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-1, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-4)
fit_criterion: After a fixture lock, every change to a locked part outside a reopen is refused; the lock record names the version number and the approver in both roles.
